map.基于作物系数法：ETc = Kc × ETo，估算作物每日需水量与灌溉定额。: Crop-coefficient method: ETc = Kc x ETo; estimate daily crop water need and irrigation quota.
map.按 FAO 参考蒸散发法：作物需水量 ETc = Kc × ET₀。ET₀ 为参: FAO reference evapotranspiration method: crop water need ETc = Kc x ET₀. ET₀ is reference crop evapotranspiration (mm/day), Kc is the growth-stage crop coefficient; their product is daily need; multiply by area and convert by irrigation efficiency to gross irrigation. Area is in mu (666.67 m²), for irrigation quota and water-saving design.
map.💡 公式：ETc = Kc × ETo；田间总水量 = ETc × 面积 × 6: 💡 Formula: ETc = Kc x ETo; field total water = ETc x area x 666.67 / 1000 / efficiency
map.参考蒸散发 ETo 可通过气象站或 Penman-Monteith 公式估算获得: ETo can be estimated from weather stations or the Penman-Monteith equation
map.作物系数 Kc 随生育期变化，苗期较小、旺盛生长期较大: Crop coefficient Kc varies by stage: small at seedling, large at vigorous growth
map.灌溉效率受喷灌/滴灌/漫灌方式影响，滴灌通常取 85%–95%: Irrigation efficiency depends on sprinkler/drip/flood method; drip usually 85%-95%
map.ETc = Kc × ETo：作物系数乘参考蒸散量。: ETc = Kc x ETo: crop coefficient times reference evapotranspiration.
map.按生育阶段取不同 Kc（苗期小、中期大）分段累计。: Use different Kc per stage (small early, large mid) and accumulate.
map.用于灌溉制度制定与缺水预警。: Used for irrigation scheduling and water-shortage early warning.
map.当地 ETo = 5.0 mm/d，灌浆期 Kc = 1.15，则 ETc =: Local ETo = 5.0 mm/d, filling Kc = 1.15, so ETc = 1.15 x 5.0 = 5.75 mm/d. Over 20 days ~ 115 mm, or 76.7 m³/mu (1 mm = 0.667 m³/mu).
map.ETo 是参考作物（草地）蒸散，由气象站提供；ETc 是具体作物的实际需水，乘作: ETo is reference crop (grass) evapotranspiration from weather stations; ETc is a specific crop's actual need, obtained by multiplying Kc. Both in mm.
map.FAO-56 给出主要作物各生育期 Kc 参考值，国内也可查《灌溉试验规范》或当: FAO-56 gives reference Kc per stage for major crops; in China consult the Irrigation Experiment Code or local academy recommendations. Mulching and shading change actual Kc.
